name: Illustration
tagline: Pictures that tell a story on their own.
description: Editorial, book and self-initiated illustration, in any medium, made or published in the last 18 months.
brief:
We look for a clear idea first and technique second. The best entries make the judges stop scrolling and look again.

  • An image that works without its caption
  • A point of view you could only get from this illustrator
  • Craft that serves the idea, not the other way round
formats: JPG or PNG, up to 4 images

name: Poster Design
tagline: Big, loud and readable from across the street.
description: Posters for events, causes, venues and brands, printed or digital. Series of up to three posters count as one entry.
brief:
A poster has a few seconds to do its job. We judge every entry at full size and from across the room.

  • One message, delivered fast
  • Type and image that work as one
  • Something we have not seen a hundred times
formats: JPG or PDF, up to 3 posters

name: Editorial Design
tagline: Magazines, books and long reads with a clear voice.
description: Spreads, covers and complete publications, in print or on screen. Send up to six spreads from the same piece.
brief:
Good editorial design makes reading easier and more pleasurable. We read the pages, not just look at them.

  • A grid and type system with a purpose
  • Pacing across pages, not just one strong spread
  • Images and words that support each other

name: Photography
description: Documentary, portrait, still life and fine art photography. A series can have up to eight frames.
brief:
We judge the picture, not the camera. Edits for clarity are fine; composites must be labelled as such.

  • A moment or subject handled with care
  • Sequencing that builds, for series
  • Honest captions and context

name: Type Design
tagline: Typefaces and lettering, from display to text.
description: Retail, custom and experimental typefaces, plus lettering projects. Include a specimen and one real-world use.
brief:
Our type jury sets each entry in real text before deciding. A beautiful headline is not enough.

  • Consistent rhythm and colour across the family
  • A clear reason for this typeface to exist
  • Spacing and kerning that hold up at size
formats: PDF specimen and a test font on request

name: Student
tagline: For anyone enrolled in a course in 2026.
description: Any discipline above, made as part of a course or in your own time while studying. Free to enter with a student email.
brief:
The student category is judged by the full jury, with the same care as every other category. Winners get a paid mentorship with a judge.

  • Ambition and curiosity over polish
  • A clear idea of who the work is for
  • A short statement about your process
